Review of the product The comb comes with a black pull string pouch and is packed into a zippered plastic case. The comb is made of green sandal wood and is two sided. The teeth are spaced at about 1/32 inch and the teeth on both sides are spaced the same. When you place

reviews.t: Nice, Nice size, but need a longer beard!
reviews.x: I order D this comb to replace one I lost. I mainly ordered because of the convenient size. The comb is nice and well made however, due to the size of the teeth I believe is more well suited for a beard longer than mines as the teeth are on the taller side and rounded. I will not rate low for that reason as I feel the comb is well made. Be sure you have a decent length beard for it to be useful.

Great beard comb. Perfect pocket size and glides through beard with ease. Also smells wonderful and comes in a nice carrying bag. Fiance said he loves it! I recieved this product for a discount in exchange for my honest review

My husband lost his flimsy plastic comb he was using. I found this one and he LOVES it. He decided a few months ago to grow his beard out and this has been such a wonderful find. He has very thick hair and it is sturdy enough to handle his thick beard. He said I may have to order a few more so he can have backup at work and in his car (just in case he loses one, too) He is so very thrilled with this comb! Thanks! Highly recommend!!

Great comb.  This is my first mustache and beard comb.  Based on the quality, this should also be my last mustache comb.  All of the edges are properly rounded.  It has a pleasant scent.  My beard oil and cream clean out of it easily.  You can purchase more expensive ones, but no need to spend the extra money.

reviews.t: Great comb for a beard, but may not be best for a mustache
reviews.x: This product was delivered exactly as it was described and pictured, but I found when trying to use it that because the ends of the comb are so wide (the end tines are very thick), I can't effectively comb the spaces right up under my nose. I still need to use a comb with a narrow end tine for that. Otherwise, this is a nifty little facial hair comb.

The come is very well made. A beautiful wood. It slides easily through my mustache and beard. I'm amazed at how the maker got the teeth so fine on a wooden comb. It's a pleasure to use every morning. A great little comb. Quite classy. Way better than a plastic comb. Love it.

reviews.t: It comes with a nice velvety bag for storage/travel
reviews.x: I bought this for my husband and he likes it so far.  His beard isn't too long yet, so it's difficult to judge the anti-snag; but he loves the smooth feel and the craftsmanship of the product, and that the product seems very durable.  It comes with a nice velvety bag for storage/travel.  Customer service has been excellent!

When it came i was pleasantly surprised at how nice it was. No scent on this one of any kind. Unfortunately just a week after i got it, the thing bent into a "U" shape and just became extremely brittle. Suffice to say this is the one and only time I've experienced this. Will not buy again.
I use these beard combs for my beard sets. Product came when expected. I love the wood smell and it also comes in a little opaque zip lock baggie! Will definitely order again.

reviews.t: A little thicker than I would like in a comb but it works great and smells ...
reviews.x: A little thicker than I would like in a comb but it works great and smells awesome!  Perfect size for my pocket

reviews.t: Good comb. Dropped it a couple times and it's ...
reviews.x: Good comb.  Dropped it a couple times and it's survived without any breaks and it smells good too.

reviews.t: Great comb for beard and mustache
reviews.x: This is a really nice natural wood comb, and very sturdy.
Very high quality. I recommend to everyone.

Not pleased with this comb.  It doesn't have the somewhat shiny finish as shown in the pictures which makes it harder to glide through your beard.  The teeth are also a little tight on this comb (coarse side) compared to other beard combs I have.  These two things combined definitely lead to more snags which is what beard combs are supposed to avoid.  I don't have the thickest or curliest beard but I still have issues with this comb.

reviews.t: As good or better than other combs that are 5x as expensive
reviews.x: I bought this after being unhappy with how another brand (that was 5x more expensive) with more "square" teeth felt on my face. To me, it feels much better to have  a slightly rounded point than square point teeth. Anyway, "face feel" aside, the build quality feels the same as the more expensive one. If you are on the fence between this one and one with better branding that cost more, save yourself some money and go with this one.

I ordered this for my husband as a birthday gift. He loves it! He has a gorgeous beard and gets compliments all the time. He loves that there are two combing options. He uses one side to comb forward and to fluff his beard. Uses the other side to smooth it. He has to wear a mask all day at work which dents his beard. Combing it with this comb takes the dent out. The comb looks very nice displayed in our bathroom too.

Excellent product!  This comb is well made and teeth are even, and it compares to a more expensive one I bought that was double in price.  Comes with felt storage pouch, beautiful wood grains, I LOVE IT!!!  Highly recommend this comb!  Although another comb I own has both wide and fine teeth, this one has fine teeth on both sides, but OK, as I usually use fine teeth side anyway.

High quality elegance, feels WONDERFUL in the hand AND on the face.  The fact that it is beautiful and smells really nice makes me want to carry it with me all the time.  BONUS: It's not too fine for me to use to comb my hair!  I LOVE this comb! UPDATE: I love this comb so much I purchased a second one for a friend.  I'm happy to say that he loves his as much as I love mine!

Good quality. I use it daily. Isnt always the most general on tangles but no wood comb would be. Use it on my hair in a jam too. Every now and then I use it on my kids hair if need be. Works well on anything. Good size easy to carry. Sturdy so far no broken prongs. Havent noticed a scent good or bad, so not sure what that's about? Over all glad I bought this for myself.

My husband purchased this and this is his review of the wooden beard comb:  "Overall I prefer this wooden beard comb to the cheap drug store plastic comb I was using previously.  The wider teeth are perfect for detangling.  The fineness of the teeth are great for styling as well as the wood absorbing any beard oil over time.  Wonderful prodcut!"

reviews.t: So close to a 5 star product.
reviews.x: My only complaint would be that the cuts are a little rough. A little sanding between the teeth would go a long way towards making this a 5 star product.  For the price I paid, it is a great product and it's easy enough to sand out the parts that will rip your beard.   Even considering the burs and slivers, I'd purchase this product again.

Bought this comb as an extra to keep in the car. This comb is better than the one I paid twice as much for. I like the spacing of the larger part of the comb because it is a medium spread and not as wide as the other comb I have. Great comb and well worth the money you won't be disappointed with this purchase

I bought this comb for my husband who is obsessed with his beard. It was supposed to be a Christmas gift but I couldn’t wait to give it to him. He loves it! It’s not big and bulky and has different comb width on each side. It goes smoothly through his beard and doesn’t pull. Very affordable, great product!

reviews.t: Don't know what I ever did without it.
reviews.x: I used to use a regular hair comb to manage my sizeable goatee. It actually made it look worse. I bought the HaWaTour after a quick search and it was an instant change. It makes my goatee look like someone styles it every morning. It saved my goatee from the razor. The wood makes it smell great too.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the comb's pleasant wood/sandalwood scent.
Many reviewers describe the comb as well made, sturdy, and durable.
Reviewers commonly highlight the convenient pocket size and easy glide through beard or mustache.
Several reviewers mention the included carrying pouch or bag as a nice touch.
A few reviewers report quality or usability problems, such as bending/brittleness, tight teeth, or wide end tines.
